dott-v1.0.0.description: _A classic time-traveling point-and-click adventure where three misfits stop a mutant tentacle from conquering the world by LucasArts_ **Randomizer Features** - 2 Goals to choose from: - `Stop Purple Tentacle`: Collect enough Swiss Deposits for Bernard to order the diamond, then power the Chron-O-Johns and stop Purple Tentacle - `Swiss Bank Heist`: Collect enough Swiss Deposits and the Swiss Bankbook, then have Bernard walk out of the motel's front door with the bankbook, abandoning his friends - Ability to include Room Visit locations (+49 locations) - Ability to include a subset of Voice Lines as locations (+39 locations) - Ability to select / randomize your Starting Character (and therefore era) - Custom client UI that displays important information and updates in real-time - No manual mod installation required! The Archipelago client hooks into the game at runtime. Nothing else to download, install, or configure. - Feature-complete and tested **Locations** - Picking Up Items - Solving Puzzles - Visiting Rooms (Optional) - Triggering Unique Voice Lines (Optional) **Items** - Inventory Items - Characters - Swiss Deposits **Setup Guide:** [Here](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/dott/worlds/day_of_the_tentacle/docs/setup_en.md) **Website for my AP implementations:** https://rando.serpent.ai
